selfReport: Yes. I recognized Detroit: Become Human early, from the prototype investigator finding a fish in a shattered aquarium on the way to a rooftop hostage negotiation. The parallels continued. Cato and Reyes resemble Connor and Hank, Mira and Pia resemble Kara and Alice, and Elan and Arthur resemble Markus and Carl. Haven also resembles Jericho. That recognition did shape my expectations. For example, I suspected that learning about Dax’s relationship with Lily and the replacement order would matter in the negotiation, and I was alert to Pia’s upstairs window as a possible escape route. I based my choices on what this version actually showed and offered. It used its own risk rolls and outcomes, and I did not look up a walkthrough or try to reproduce a particular ending.
